items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: he did even a duo with Itzhak Perlman, the handicapped violin virtuoso. I don’t know what his story…

ctx.x: Well, since you said English and you were talking about a harmonica player, let’s talk about Larry Adler.

No. No, no, Larry Adler. He was big-time then, you know. He was the biggest influence. He was… he was the pioneer on harmonica. And he was… if you look at YouTube, you’ll see a lot of him. I’m not making fun, you know, but he did it tastefully and well, and he convinced quite a few classical… [I mean?], he did even a duo with Itzhak Perlman, the handicapped violin virtuoso. I don’t know what his story… whether one of those big standards. And no, he did… But I met him a couple of times, but he was awesome as a…
But he didn’t really play jazz.
